attributes.title: Level 1

subgroups.name: Discover

steps.text: Ready to create with MakeCode Arcade? Watch this video to learn more about how you can use code to communicate with computers to build exciting projects!

questions.hint: What type of instructions is a computer able to read?
questions.title: [Select one] What does a computer need to be able to do amazing things?

answers.text: A daily confidence boost of at least 5 compliments
Complete silence and time to think

questions.correctResponse: Computers need a little human guidance in the form of coded instructions.

questions.hint: What does a computer program do?
questions.title: [Select one] What is a computer program?

answers.text: A set of instructions written in code
A TV show with 0 to 1 episodes
A difficult dance number performed by robots
A piece of paper with  “computer program” written on it

questions.correctResponse: A computer program tells a computer what to do.

questions.hint: What language gives instructions for the computer to follow?
questions.title: [Select one] Which of the following languages does a computer understand?
questions.correctResponse: Remember computers don’t understand human languages!

questions.hint: What happens when you come across a bug when coding a project?
questions.title: [Select one] Having errors is not part of the process of coding, and you should stop immediately when you encounter one.
questions.correctResponse: Debugging errors is a major part of coding, and even professional coders spend a lot of time fixing their code!

questions.hint: What else might you do while coding at Code Ninjas?
questions.title: [Select one] What will you use computer science to do at Code Ninjas?
questions.correctResponse: Here at Code Ninjas, you will be  building, discovering, and solving with computer science!

subgroups.title: Computer Science!
subgroups.introduction: Ready to create with MakeCode Arcade? Watch this video to learn more about how you can use code to communicate with computers to build exciting projects!

attributes.description: Welcome to Level 1 of White Belt! In this level, you’ll learn about using code to create your first projects at Code Ninjas! Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 1:

badges.title: The Journey Begins
badges.description: Use the MakeCode Arcade platform to code a project.

badges.title: Sprite Place at the Sprite Time
badges.description: Create a new sprite and set its position.

badges.title: Painter’s Palette
badges.description: Change the background color of a project.

badges.title: First Words
badges.description: Make a sprite say something on screen.

badges.title: Hearts, Smiles, and Bubbles, Oh My!
badges.description: Add screen effects to a project.

badges.title: Maestro
badges.description: Play a sound in a project.
